activity_summary: By seven the sheet had eleven new lines. She is asking the day to be done so that night will come. You did not write a dawn. You did not write anything to send.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the eleven lines, and did not copy them fair, and did not send them.

entities.name: Verona
entities.context: Mentioned in Eleven lines, by seven

facets.activity: Put eleven lines on her sheet
